columns.description: List of columns to display; valid values: filesystem, type, bar, used, used_percentage, available, available_percentage, capacity, mounted_on

human_readable.description: Print sizes in powers of 1024 (equivalent to -h)

si.description: Print sizes in powers of 1000 (equivalent to -H)

inodes.description: Show inode usage instead of block usage (equivalent to -i)

total.description: Produce and show a grand total line (equivalent to --total)

local.description: Limit listing to local file systems (equivalent to -l)

color.description: When to colorize output; must be 'auto', 'always', or 'never'

no_aliases.description: Disable filesystem shorthand alias resolution (e.g., LVM)
